tools.formula: Companies Act illustration = (cost − residual) ÷ useful life × days ÷ 365; Income Tax illustration = opening WDV × rate × 50% when used below 180 days, otherwise the full entered rate
limitations: Useful lives, residual values, blocks, rates, component accounting and tax eligibility are not inferred.
The output is illustrative arithmetic, not a statutory books or return schedule.

sources.title: Companies Act and Schedule II reference material
sources.notes: Schedule II supports the Companies Act useful-life mode only.

sources.title: Income Tax allowances allowable to taxpayers — Section 32
sources.publisher: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance
sources.notes: Supports WDV block treatment and the 50% restriction for qualifying assets used below 180 days.

tools.name: Maharashtra Professional Tax Calculator

result.notice: Maharashtra reference schedule only. Verify the current state notification, exemption, salary definition, gender rule and filing period before use.

tools.formula: Reference PT = selected Maharashtra slab for declared monthly salary, with February adjustment where applicable
limitations: Only a Maharashtra reference schedule is included.
Exemptions, employer registration, state changes, salary definitions and notifications require review.

sources.title: Profession Tax and Other Rate Schedule
sources.publisher: Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Department
sources.notes: Reference schedule is state-specific and must be checked against the current notification and taxpayer facts.

tools.name: MSME Late-payment Interest Calculator

result.notice: Reference arithmetic only. Eligibility, acceptance, agreed terms, bank-rate changes and monthly-rest treatment require reviewed records and the applicable MSMED process.

tools.formula: Reference interest = principal × [(1 + 3 × bank rate ÷ 12)^full months − 1] plus remainder-day interest
limitations: The result does not determine MSE status, acceptance, written terms, bank rate or dispute process.
One declared bank-rate snapshot is used; later rate changes across a long overdue period are not modelled.
Trading and unknown enterprise types are not treated as eligible by default.

sources.title: Delayed Payments to Micro and Small Enterprises
sources.publisher: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
sources.notes: The result separates reference eligibility from arithmetic and does not initiate an MSEFC or Samadhaan process.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India rates and notifications
sources.notes: Bank rate is entered by the user; the tool does not fetch or determine the applicable rate.

result.notice: Reference or manual conversion only. Bank, card, remittance and settlement rates may differ.

tools.formula: Converted amount = amount × quoted or manual rate
limitations: ECB reference rates are informational and may differ from bank, card, remittance or settlement rates.
Network failure does not silently reuse an old quote; manual fallback is explicit.
